content.comment_body: Hello, I downloaded for the first time from [product_name] Web Editor onto the SD card in the [product_name] Basis Module, which was successful. However, my second attempt to download after making some changes did not work. I have attached a screenshot showing the error message. I’m unsure why the download failed. Is there somewhere I can review the reason for a "download failed" error?

Hello, I closed the previous [product_name] Web Editor session, opened a new window, and continued—now there’s no issue. It would still be helpful to understand what caused the "download failed" error.

A download retrieves data from [product_name], while an upload sends data to [product_name]. If there wasn’t an earlier upload, you cannot download. I believe the first action was still handled locally.

From Help - Download: Use this feature to download a [product_name] Web Editor project from your PC to the Micro SD card of the [product_name] Basis Module. You can also use the respective toolbar button for this task. For uploading: Use this command to upload a [product_name] Web Editor project from the Micro SD card of the [product_name] Basis Module to the PC, also accessible via the toolbar.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced an ambiguous error while attempting to download a project from [product_name] Web Editor to a microSD card within the [product_name] Basis Module. The error message lacked specific context, creating confusion and prompting multiple download attempts. The source of the failure is not clearly accessible or explained in the software interface or documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear, detailed error information that explains the reason for download failures, along with guidance or troubleshooting steps within the [product_name] Web Editor interface or documentation.
